function: Quantum-aided actor-critic DRL learns UAV-RIS phase shifts and DoA estimate for sensing, and vehicle power, rates and CPU allocation for task offloading in ISAC (pp. 10, 14).
system: Vehicle MISO uplink (M antennas) to single-antenna UAVs and LEO satellites (550 km); 16 UAVs carry 64-element 2-bit reflecting RIS; 2.4 GHz radar (pp. 3, 5, 13).
method: Quantum-aided multi-agent actor-critic reinforcement learning: variational quantum circuits, amplitude-encoded states, replay buffer; two agents (DoA, task offloading) with Nash-equilibrium reward (pp. 10-12).
data_channel: Own simulation: Rician fading (factor 6.46), log-distance path loss with shadowing, random-waypoint mobility, 4 km2 urban area; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4-6, 13).
test_conditions: One simulated setup (16 UAVs, 4 UFOs, 8 satellites, 2 vehicles, 64-element RIS), 100-run averages; sweeps of sensing time, RIS size, SNR, bandwidth; no train/test shift stated (pp. 13-15).
baselines: Random RIS phase shifts, satellite-MEC-only task split (non-learned); DDPG [19] and PPO [20] (learned); CRLB as bound (pp. 14-15).
metrics: RMSE of DoA, normalized reward, convergence episodes, task offloading latency, detection probability, runtime complexity (pp. 14-16).
complexity: Order O(log D + G_U n_U + I U n) (p. 12); analytic runtime orders compared with PPO O(TBd + Bd^2) and DDPG O(Bd + Bd^2) (pp. 15-16).
q1_support: p. 4: "Rician fading channel. This model includes LoS and non-LoS". Custom Rician, log-distance and free-space path-loss simulator (factor 6.46, p. 13); no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing dataset or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 14: "are averaged over 100 simulation runs to ensure statistical". Sweeps over sensing time, RIS elements, SNR, bandwidth and block length (Figs. 4-7) are shown, but no model trained in one condition is stated to be tested or adapted in another.
q3_support: p. 14: "RMSE compared to an RIS design with random phase" and "DDPG, and PPO-based phase shift designs". Non-learned random RIS phase shifts and learned DDPG [19] and PPO [20] are compared on DoA RMSE and offloading latency (p. 15).
q4_support: p. 12: "computational complexity is expressed as" Eq. (83), O(log D + G_U n_U + I U n); pp. 15-16 compare the analytic runtime complexity with PPO and DDPG (Fig. 8).
q5_support: p. 14: "We employ an 8-qubit quantum system on Google Cirq,". Training and test data come from the paper's own simulation (pp. 4-6, 13); no code or data link, public dataset or measurement is mentioned.
notes: Borderline: DoA estimation alone and task offloading alone would be excluded (function, above_phy). Included because the agents also learn UAV-RIS phase shifts and vehicle power and rates (a_DoA, a_TASK, p. 10) jointly with offloading, so a physical-layer decision is learned together with one above it. ISAC (area 5) and NTN (area 6) both fit; area 6 chosen by the specificity order because the learned controls act on UAV and satellite links, reviewer may prefer 5. Channel is a custom simulator, hence q1 is 0.
